verdict.rationale: Stagehand's docs include reference pages (e.g. the BrowserClipboard reference) and copy-paste snippets. Nothing in the pack shows an interactive API reference or examples that run in the browser, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. Static reference pages and copy-paste code do not meet the interactive, runnable requirement, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
